mapper.select: SELECT mc.id, mc.member_email, mc.challenge_id, mc.status, mc.current_streak, mc.start_date, mc.end_date, mc.last_check_date, c.title, c.target_days FROM tbl_member_challenge mc JOIN tbl_challenge c ON mc.challenge_id = c.challenge_id WHERE mc.member_email = #{email} AND mc.status = 'ONGOING'
SELECT challenge_id, title, description, target_days, success_point, fail_point, active FROM tbl_challenge WHERE challenge_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_member_challenge (member_email, challenge_id, status, current_streak, start_date, end_date, last_check_date) VALUES (#{memberEmail}, #{challengeId}, #{status}, #{currentStreak}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{lastCheckDate})
mapper.select: SELECT mc.*, c.title, c.target_days FROM tbl_member_challenge mc JOIN tbl_challenge c ON mc.challenge_id = c.challenge_id WHERE mc.id = #{id} AND mc.member_email = #{email}
